#!/usr/bin/env bash
# capture.sh — capture desktop and mobile screenshots of the running app
set -euo pipefail

CAPTURE_URL="${CAPTURE_URL:?CAPTURE_URL environment variable is required}"
CAPTURE_DIR="${CAPTURE_DIR:?CAPTURE_DIR environment variable is required}"

# Per-command timing helper
time_run() {
  echo "=== TIMING START: $* ==="
  /usr/bin/time -p "$@"
  echo "=== TIMING END: $* ==="
}

time_run mkdir -p "$CAPTURE_DIR"

CHROME_PID=""

cleanup() {
  if [[ -n "${CHROME_PID:-}" ]]; then
    kill "$CHROME_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$CHROME_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# ── Helper: capture one screenshot with Chromium ──
# Uses --headless --screenshot which writes screenshot.png to cwd and exits.
capture_one() {
  local size="$1" out="$2" ua="$3"
  local capdir
  capdir="$(mktemp -d)"
  local args=(
    --headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox
    --screenshot --window-size="$size"
    --virtual-time-budget=15000
    --user-data-dir="$(mktemp -d)"
    "$CAPTURE_URL"
  )
  if [[ -n "$ua" ]]; then
    args=(--user-agent="$ua" "${args[@]}")
  fi

  (cd "$capdir" && time_run chromium "${args[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

  if [[ -f "$capdir/screenshot.png" && -s "$capdir/screenshot.png" ]]; then
    cp "$capdir/screenshot.png" "$out"
    rm -rf "$capdir"
  else
    rm -rf "$capdir"
    echo "ERROR: Chromium did not produce a screenshot for $size" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

MOBILE_UA="Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; Mobile) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36"

# ── Desktop capture ──
capture_one "1280,720" "$CAPTURE_DIR/final-desktop.png" ""
echo "Desktop screenshot saved: $CAPTURE_DIR/final-desktop.png"

# ── Mobile capture ──
capture_one "375,667" "$CAPTURE_DIR/final-mobile.png" "$MOBILE_UA"
echo "Mobile screenshot saved: $CAPTURE_DIR/final-mobile.png"

# ── Verify both files exist and are non-empty ──
for f in "$CAPTURE_DIR/final-desktop.png" "$CAPTURE_DIR/final-mobile.png"; do
  if [[ ! -s "$f" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Screenshot missing or empty: $f" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

echo "Capture complete. App left running."
---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# start.sh — build and serve the ZOMBIE PINS HTML5 game
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"

# Per-command timing helper
time_run() {
  echo "=== TIMING START: $* ==="
  /usr/bin/time -p "$@"
  echo "=== TIMING END: $* ==="
}

# ── Build: prepare static output directory inside PROJECT_DIR ──
time_run mkdir -p dist

# Copy the single-file HTML5 game as dist/index.html (runtime entry point)
time_run cp zombie-pins-dackel.html dist/index.html

# ── Write deployment-output.json for the controller ──
DEPLOY_DIR="${OPENCODE_WEB_DIR:-/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-web}"
time_run mkdir -p "$DEPLOY_DIR"
cat > "$DEPLOY_DIR/deployment-output.json" <<JSONEOF
{"project":"$PROJECT_DIR","directory":"$PROJECT_DIR/dist"}
JSONEOF

# Also write to the exact path requested
time_run mkdir -p /home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-web
cat > /home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-web/deployment-output.json <<JSONEOF
{"project":"$PROJECT_DIR","directory":"$PROJECT_DIR/dist"}
JSONEOF

# ── Serve in the foreground on PORT (default 3000) ──
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
echo "Serving static output from $PROJECT_DIR/dist on port $PORT"
exec python3 -m http.server "$PORT" --directory dist

```js
function spacedText(text,x,y,spacing,align='center'){
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  const widths=[...text].map(ch=>ctx.measureText(ch).width);
  const total=widths.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)+spacing*(text.length-1);
  let cx = align==='center'? x-total/2 : align==='right'? x-total : x;
  for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){ctx.fillText(text[i],cx,y);cx+=widths[i]+spacing;}
  return total;
}
```

Segment collision response:
```js
function collideSegment(b,ax,ay,bx,by){
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay; const l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 let t=((b.x-ax)*dx+(b.y-ay)*dy)/l2; t=clamp(t,0,1);
 const cx=ax+dx*t, cy=ay+dy*t;
 let nx=b.x-cx, ny=b.y-cy; const d=Math.hypot(nx,ny);
 if(d<b.r){
   if(d===0){nx=0;ny=-1;} else {nx/=d;ny/=d;}
   const penetration=b.r-d;
   b.x+=nx*penetration; b.y+=ny*penetration;
   const vn=b.vx*nx+b.vy*ny;
   if(vn<0){ b.vx-=(1+0.55)*vn*nx; b.vy-=(1+0.55)*vn*ny; }
   return true;
 }
 return false;
}
```

For fill text letter spacing, define:
```js
function spaced(g, text, x, y, sp, align){
  const chars=[...text];
  let total=0;
  for(const ch of chars) total+=g.measureText(ch).width;
  total+=sp*Math.max(0,chars.length-1);
  let cx = align==='center'?x-total/2 : align==='right'?x-total : x;
  for(const ch of chars){ g.fillText(ch,cx,y); cx+=g.measureText(ch).width+sp; }
  return total;
}
```

  roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,10); ctx.fillStyle=lg; ctx.fill();
  // liquid

  const liq=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);
  liq.addColorStop(0,'rgba(90,160,60,0.12)'); liq.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,220,80,0.28)');

}

let last=performance.now(), acc=0;

  let steps=0;

  if(steps===3) acc=0;
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
